  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The assignment-prefix parser does not recognize `NAME+=value`, so a command such as `COUNT+=1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x` bypasses the merged-PR guard.
  WHY: The parser fails to locate the `git push` command and allows the push; reviewers report this also causes guard tests and the required CI check to fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19513-19520 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cycle-tail verifier call can retry every poll tick when the verifier does not produce a complete-verdict marker, repeatedly running `git fetch`, creating a worktree, and invoking codex.
  WHY: Partial verdicts and failed issue or comment posts leave no marker or comment for the dedup check at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:580-585 to match, so completed projects can trigger an expensive retry on every poll.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19513-19520 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fifth verifier call site adds recurring activation-verification work for completed projects without a retry-cap setting or documented bound.
  WHY: Enabling `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED` now opts the poller into verification on every tick for eligible completed projects, beyond the documented one-shot behavior.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:147-172 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Three distinct file-unavailability failure conditions emit the same `reason=files_unavailable` log reason.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish a multi-commit rebase, a failed fallback diff, and an empty fallback diff during triage.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The assignment-prefix parser matches only simple `NAME=` assignments and does not recognize `NAME+=value`, unlike the workflow-template guard.
  WHY: `COUNT+=1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x` is not parsed as a git command, bypassing the merged-PR guard; the reviewer reports five failing tests, including the workflow-template byte-parity contract test.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:275 | issue: stdout and stderr of operator_step_issue.py are redirected to /dev/null, concealing the specific error cause when updating the ai:operator-step issue fails. Suggested minimal fix: redirect output to a temporary log file under RUNTIME_DIR and display the error message in the warning annotation when the command fails. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:146 | issue: parts list contains an empty string element between the header and intro text, causing multiple consecutive blank lines when joined with double newlines. Suggested minimal fix: remove the empty string element so parts is defined as [MARKER, "## Operator steps", INTRO]. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: 19513-19520 (5th call site) combined with the dedup check inside `run_project_activation_verify` at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:580-585 and the partial-verdict comment shape at scripts/activation_verify.sh:~285 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The fifth verifier call site retries on every poll tick when a partial verdict or a failed issue/comment post leaves no complete-verdict marker for the dedup check.
  WHY: Each retry can perform `git fetch`, `git worktree add`, and a codex invocation lasting up to `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECS:-1500`, repeatedly consuming runner time for the lifetime of the tracking issue.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh: 147-172 (the three `reason=files_unavailable` log sites) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Three distinct failure conditions all log `ACTIVATION_VERIFY mode=pr item=N outcome=skip reason=files_unavailable`.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish the parent-count condition, a failed fallback diff, and a fallback output rejected by the new validation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: 19513-19520 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The fifth `run_project_activation_verify` invocation runs on every poll tick for every already-completed project, expanding the implicit-execution surface without a retry cap.
  WHY: `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED=true` now opts the poller into recurring verification work, including a worktree, codex execution, and ai:operator-step tracker writes; no `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_RETRY_*` or `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` setting controls this path.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description and the agents.md "Activation verification (port P4) and operator steps (Q33)." bullet both state that `run_project_activation_verify` "runs after every `emit_orchestrator_completion_lessons` call (all 4 completion paths)".
  Expected change site: agents.md around the "Activation verification (port P4)" bullet at lines around 1751 (the bullet introduced by this PR at agents.md:1751) and the PR description section "## What changes / Poller."; the changelog fragment changelog.d/6118-phase-8c-activation-verification.md would also need updating if the prose is canonical.
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19513-19520) adds a 5th `run_project_activation_verify` call site inside the `if [ "${PROJECT_STATUS}" = "complete" ] || [ "${PROJECT_STATUS}" = "failed" ] || [ "${PROJECT_STATUS}" = "validation-failed" ]` cycle-tail block. This call site is NOT preceded by `emit_orchestrator_completion_lessons`, and the block as a whole is the post-completion retry path — distinct from the four completion paths. The added test only asserts a literal substring of the 5th call site (`'if [ "${PROJECT_STATUS}" = "complete" ]; then\n      run_project_activation_verify'`) and does not pin documentation accuracy. Both agents.md and the PR description remain inaccurate after the PR is merged.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description states the new behavior is "when an orchestrator project completes, the poller runs it in `project` mode".
  Expected change site: README.md (the `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED` row around lines 81), agents.md bullet, and PR description.
  Evidence of absence: README.md's `ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED` row describes "after a PR merges into the default branch" and "when an orchestrator project completes" but does not mention the post-completion retry path or its bounds. The agents.md bullet mentions only "after every emit_orchestrator_completion_lessons call". Neither mentions per-tick retries on completed projects.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/activation_verify.sh:285 and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:580-585 | Partial verdicts lack a stable marker the dedup check can match; suggested fix is to append a partial marker and update the dedup predicate. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/activation_verify.sh:147-172 | Three distinct failure conditions share one log reason; suggested fix is to distinguish the outcomes with separate reason tokens. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
